config.capacity: No scaling or routing unless a learned candidate improves the strongest matched simple reference by at least 5% on development
config.comparison: paired errors on identical outer biological-group folds; source-only inner selection; descriptive group bootstrap
config.confirmation: none; existing pilot is exposed and new public single source is development
config.extensions: Dose, identity-only unknown interventions, higher-order and temporal claims are unsupported unless separately source-qualified
config.population: All supported condition means in each declared source, fixed across models; no cell-count weighting
config.pretraining: No external expression or descriptor pretraining; downstream source singles pretrain staged encoders; no-pretraining and frozen/fine-tuned comparisons retain the same labels
config.primary_metric: equal-condition mean squared error over the frozen gene vocabulary

reliability.status: experimental; requires separate risk-fit, calibration and fresh evaluation groups

fixed_evaluation_population: observed singles with same exact intervention available in outer training
gene_panel: source-declared controls-only panel; query-control gene selection adaptation is declared for legacy EmeraldBay

information_contract.exposure: development; source exposure described in source audit; not independent confirmation

oracle: measured query singles; evaluator diagnostic only
preprocessing: control PCA, scales, source means and response bases fitted per training fold
unsupported_population: reported before modeling, identical across candidates
